caveats: 311 of 3600 grid cells in the region are not sea cells (SST not finite on every target day) and are set to 0 in the mask. The last event ends on the final target day (2022-08-31). Thresholds/climatology pools use 11-day windows (baseline dates +/-5 calendar days), hazen 90th percentile, day-of-year 60 averaged from days 59/61, then 31-day circular smoothing.
